fsm_states.name: IDLE
fsm_states.description: Bus free; SDA and SCL both HIGH (released by all devices).

fsm_states.name: START_DETECT
fsm_states.description: Master generates HIGH→LOW on SDA while SCL HIGH; bus becomes busy.

fsm_states.name: ADDR_TRANSMIT
fsm_states.description: Master transmits 7-bit slave address + R/W bit; 8 SCL pulses.

fsm_states.name: ADDR_ACK_WAIT
fsm_states.description: 9th SCL pulse: master releases SDA; addressed slave pulls SDA LOW to ACK.

fsm_states.name: DATA_TRANSMIT
fsm_states.description: Transmitter (master or slave depending on R/W) drives 8 data bits MSB-first on SDA.

fsm_states.name: DATA_ACK_WAIT
fsm_states.description: 9th SCL pulse: receiver pulls SDA LOW for ACK or leaves HIGH for NACK.

fsm_states.name: CLOCK_STRETCH
fsm_states.description: Slave holds SCL LOW to delay next byte (optional handshake).

fsm_states.name: ARBITRATION_LOSS
fsm_states.description: Master detected SDA actual LOW while it drove HIGH; turns off SDA driver; falls back to slave mode if it has one.

fsm_states.name: STOP_GENERATE
fsm_states.description: Master generates LOW→HIGH on SDA while SCL HIGH; bus free.

fsm_states.name: REPEATED_START
fsm_states.description: Master generates new START without intervening STOP; keeps bus busy.

fsm_hints.trigger: Continuous superframe locked to the sample rate; the main node is the timing master and the discovery sequence is gated by segment-by-segment phantom-power switching.
fsm_hints.rule: A sub node must achieve clock recovery then superframe lock before it can be discovered and addressed; a downstream node cannot be discovered before its upstream neighbor.
fsm_hints.abort: Loss of bus lock at a node breaks the chain downstream of it and is reported upstream to the main node.

anti_deadlock_rule: There is a single timing master (the main node) and an ordered, power-gated discovery sequence, so there is no bus arbitration and no deadlock at the protocol layer. A node that loses lock simply re-runs clock recovery and superframe lock.
exit_from_reset: After reset, the device must release both SDA and SCL (both HIGH). Master can begin a transaction only when both lines are HIGH (bus free). Bus-clear procedure: if SDA stuck LOW, master sends 9 SCL pulses to allow the stuck device to release.

channel_dependency_rules_master.note: Master generates START / STOP / repeated START; drives SCL; drives SDA during address byte and during write data bytes; releases SDA during read data bytes for slave to drive.

channel_dependency_rules_slave.note: Slave samples SDA on rising edge of SCL; drives SDA during read data bytes; may pull SCL LOW to clock-stretch; may NACK to indicate inability to continue.

arbitration_rule: Bit-by-bit on SDA while SCL HIGH: each master checks SDA level matches what it sent. First master to drive SDA HIGH while another drives LOW loses arbitration and switches off its SDA driver. No information is lost — the winning master's transaction continues normally.
synchronization_rule: Clock synchronization via wired-AND on SCL: combined SCL LOW period = longest LOW among contending masters; combined SCL HIGH period = shortest HIGH among contending masters.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-on the main node is configured first; only the main node has power initially. The host then runs discovery, which switches phantom power onto each next segment in turn, powering and enumerating the sub nodes from the node nearest the main node outward.

fsm_states_sub_node_lock.name: POWER_OFF
fsm_states_sub_node_lock.description: Sub node transceiver unpowered; awaits phantom power on its B-side segment.

fsm_states_sub_node_lock.name: POWERED
fsm_states_sub_node_lock.description: Phantom power applied; transceiver boots and begins detecting activity on the B-side twisted pair.

fsm_states_sub_node_lock.name: CLOCK_RECOVERY
fsm_states_sub_node_lock.description: Recover the bus clock from the upstream line transitions.

fsm_states_sub_node_lock.name: SUPERFRAME_LOCK
fsm_states_sub_node_lock.description: Align to the superframe SYNC; achieve superframe (bus) lock.

fsm_states_sub_node_lock.name: DISCOVERED
fsm_states_sub_node_lock.description: Respond to discovery; receive an assigned node address; report ID registers.

fsm_states_sub_node_lock.name: CONFIGURED
fsm_states_sub_node_lock.description: Host has written audio slot, I2S/TDM, I2C, GPIO, interrupt configuration via tunneled registers.

fsm_states_sub_node_lock.name: OPERATIONAL
fsm_states_sub_node_lock.description: Extract downstream slots, insert upstream slots, re-time and forward the superframe to the next node.

fsm_states_sub_node_lock.name: LOSS_OF_LOCK
fsm_states_sub_node_lock.description: Bus lock lost; chain downstream of this node breaks; reported upstream via interrupt; retry from CLOCK_RECOVERY.

fsm_states_main_node.name: MAIN_INIT
fsm_states_main_node.description: Main node configured by host over local I2C; generates bus clock and superframe sync.

fsm_states_main_node.name: DISCOVERING
fsm_states_main_node.description: Run the ordered discovery sequence, switching phantom power segment-by-segment and assigning node addresses.

fsm_states_main_node.name: RUNNING
fsm_states_main_node.description: Transmit superframes downstream and collect the upstream portion; bridge host I2S/TDM + I2C to the bus.

fsm_states_main_node.name: FAULT
fsm_states_main_node.description: A line or power fault or loss-of-lock was reported upstream; present a single interrupt to the host for triage.
